method: sessions. Supersedes mri_acq_params_r057 for the paper's text: r057 read four of the ten M. mulatta brains from copies that hold
no acqp file (so no scanner fields) and said the other six had no raw session. All ten have one; r057 stays as it is.
sessions    MM1-MM10 (MR243, MR249-MR254, MR256, MR257, MR261): $LINC_RAW/mri_mm/<session> (PV 5.1;
MR252 exists under two spellings with the same content, the first is read). MF5-MF7 (MF278, MF275, MF282):
$LINC_RAW/mri_mf/<session>, every session folder of the brain, as in r057. Read only.
per scan    every numbered scan folder with a method file and acquired data (fid or rawdata.job0): Method; TE (EPI methods:
EchoTime, the spin-echo time); PVM_RepetitionTime; segments; averages; resolution and matrix; scan time; diffusion
timing PVM_DwGradDur / PVM_DwGradSep (delta / Delta); the effective b-values (PVM_DwEffBval: count of
b < 200 s/mm^2 = b0 volumes, maximum). From acqp: ACQ_institution, ACQ_station, ACQ_sw_version, BF1 (MHz).
b0 series   the diffusion scans at the resolution of the curated b0 (data/_lcn_src/data/curated/<S>/dwi_b0.nii.gz). The
curated b0 is volume 0 of that series (lcn_atlas step0_structure_curated_data_macaque.extract_b0: fslroi <dwi> 0 1).
MM brains: every daiDtiEpi scan of the session at that resolution with delta 15 ms, b0 scans included, as acquired
(MM4 and MM5 hold one more single-volume b0 scan than the 515 curated volumes use). MF brains: r057's rule, the
largest contiguous block of such scans with no b0 volume, plus the b0 scan just before it.
b_shells    the distinct effective b-values of the series' diffusion-weighted volumes, rounded to 100 s/mm^2 (count, least, most).
scanner     the acqp fields of the series' scans (not of other scans in the session). tesla = BF1 / 42.577 MHz per tesla (the
proton's gyromagnetic ratio), one decimal.
summary     per group (MM = the ten M. mulatta brains, MF = MF5-MF7): the distinct values of each parameter over its brains.
check       for the four brains r057 also read (MR253, MR254, MR256, MR257; other copies of the sessions): whether the series'
parameters agree with r057's.
